applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of adults with type 2 diabetes, by region and sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region and sex: adults with type 2 diabetes who have a BMI and their mean BMI, one decimal.
